notes.subject: mũndũũku
notes.rationale: כדמן nĩ mũndũũku wa ndũrũrĩ — maũndũ ma nyamũ marĩa mahũthĩkaga kũhĩa shamba, ti kiugo gĩa kũheania tu

notes.subject: ciana-inĩ
notes.rationale: פני השדene literal nĩ 'thĩinĩ wa kĩehere kĩa shamba' — 'face of the field' nĩ mũhiano wa Kĩhibirania

notes.subject: לא יאמרו
notes.rationale: andũ matarĩ kũgira makuga 'Ũyũ nĩ Iziberi' — nĩgetha mũigua wake ũhoore o ng'ania agĩtee; KJV na JPS iugaga 'so that they shall not say'

notes.subject: Iziberi
notes.rationale: maũndũ maya ni mahoya Iziberi mwanya wake — ũira wa gũkũra Rĩĩtwa-inĩ

translation: Mũigua wa Iziberi witĩkĩte ta mũndũũku igũrũ rĩ ciana-inĩ ya Yizereeri, harĩa kĩgwa kĩa Yizereeri kĩrĩ, nĩguo andũ makehota kũgira makuga atĩrĩ: Ũyũ nĩ Iziberi.
